verdict.rationale: The Emerging Companies & Growth page says the firm draws on its strength as "the world's leading capital markets and M&A firm" to position clients for an optimal liquidity event. It also cites going public via direct listings and deSPACs, and LathamDrive organizes its resources through "Liquidity" and "Beyond IPO" stages. Together these document exit support for venture-backed companies on first-party pages. Missing for 10: specific venture-backed M&A or IPO deal examples or track-record detail, depth beyond marketing statements, and independent corroboration.
